rules.title: Suspicious equality implementation
rules.description: Equals method that does not use any instance members or other instance is suspicious.

rules.title: Suspicious exception handling: only the 'Message' property is observed in the catch block
rules.description: In many cases the 'Message' property contains irrelevant information and actual data is kept in inner exceptions.

rules.title: Suspiciously unobserved result
rules.description: Return values of some methods should always be observed.

rules.title: ConfigureAwait(false) call is redundant
rules.description: The assembly is configured not to use .ConfigureAwait(false).

rules.title: ConfigureAwait(false) must be used
rules.description: The assembly is configured to use .ConfigureAwait(false).

rules.title: Awaiting a result of a null-conditional expression will cause NullReferenceException
rules.description: Null-conditional operator returns null when 'lhs' is null, causing NRE when a task is awaited.

rules.title: Avoid async-void delegates
rules.description: Async-void delegates can cause application to crash.

rules.title: A task instance is implicitly converted to a string
rules.description: An implicit conversion of a task instance to a string potentially indicates an lack of 'await'.

rules.title: Observe and Dispose a 'CancellationTokenRegistration' to avoid memory leaks
rules.description: Failure to dispose 'CancellationTokenRegistration' may cause a memory leak if obtained from a non-local token.

rules.title: Avoid using default ToString implementation
rules.description: A default ToString implementation is rarely gives the result you need.

rules.title: Avoid using Enumerable.Contains on HashSet<T>
rules.description: Enumerable.Contains is less efficient since it scans all the entries in the hashset and allocates an iterator.

rules.title: A hash table "unfriendly" type is used as the key in a hash table
rules.description: The default implementation of 'Equals' and 'GetHashCode' for structs is inefficient and could cause severe performance issues.

rules.title: Avoid using default Equals or HashCode implementation from structs
rules.description: The default implementation of 'Equals' and 'GetHashCode' for structs is inefficient and could cause severe performance issues.

rules.title: Do not use tasks in using block
rules.description: Task implements IDisposable but should not be ever disposed explicitly.

rules.title: Avoid async void methods
rules.description: Async void methods are dangerous and should be avoided except for event handlers.

rules.title: Do not use ExcludeFromCodeCoverage on partial classes
rules.description: Applying ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute to a partial class can lead to inconsistent code coverage results.

rules.title: ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute should provide a message
rules.description: Always provide a message when using ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute to document the reason for exclusion.

rules.title: Method calls itself recursively
rules.description: Detects when a method calls itself recursively, either conditionally or unconditionally.

rules.title: Do not return null for Task-like types
rules.description: Returning null for a Task-like type may lead to NullReferenceException when the task is awaited. Return Task.CompletedTask instead.

rules.title: TaskCompletionSource should use RunContinuationsAsynchronously
rules.description: Always use TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously when creating TaskCompletionSource to avoid potential deadlocks.

rules.title: Do not use Thread.Sleep in async methods
rules.description: Thread.Sleep blocks the thread and defeats the purpose of async programming. Use Task.Delay with await instead.

rules.title: Method return value marked with MustUseResultAttribute must be used
rules.description: Methods marked with MustUseResultAttribute return values that should always be observed and used.

rules.title: Do not block unnecessarily in async methods
rules.description: Synchronously blocking on Tasks inside an async method can lead to deadlocks. Use 'await' instead.

rules.title: Do not use async delegates with Task.Factory.StartNew and TaskCreationOptions.LongRunning
rules.description: TaskCreationOptions.LongRunning is intended for long-running synchronous work. Using it with async delegates wastes thread pool threads and defeats the purpose of using async methods in this case.

rules.title: Do not validate arguments in async methods eagerly
rules.description: Argument validation in async methods does not throw exceptions eagerly. The exception is thrown when the task is awaited, which can lead to unexpected behavior.

rules.title: Do not re-enumerate IEnumerable<Task>
rules.description: Enumerating an IEnumerable<Task> more than once (for example, via Task.WhenAll followed by a foreach over the same enumerable) re-executes the underlying task producer and creates a new, unrelated set of tasks. Materialize with .ToArray() or .ToList() before observing.

rules.title: Same enumerable iterated more than once inside a loop
rules.description: Iterating the same enumerable more than once inside a loop turns an O(N) walk into an O(N*M) one. Materialize the source with .ToList()/.ToArray() before the loop, or restructure to enumerate once.

rules.title: Multiple enumeration of deferred query passed to private method
rules.description: When a private method enumerates its IEnumerable<T> parameter multiple times and a caller passes a deferred LINQ query, every enumeration re-runs the entire query. The analyzer cross-references all (up to 3) private call sites and reports only when a caller passes a deferred query. Materialize the source (.ToList()/.ToArray()) before passing, or change the parameter type to IReadOnlyList<T>/T[].

rules.title: Format string does not match arguments
rules.description: Format-string placeholders (e.g. '{0}', '{1}') do not match the arguments supplied to a user-annotated formatting method; the call would throw FormatException at runtime. Annotate formatting methods via 'dotnet_diagnostic.EPC41.format_methods' in .editorconfig (e.g. MyCorp.Logger.Log:0).

rules.title: Incorrect exception propagation
rules.description: Incorrect exception propagation alters the stack trace of a thrown exception.

rules.title: Unobserved exception in a generic exception handler
rules.description: A generic catch block swallows an exception that was not observed.

rules.title: The API is not thread-safe
rules.description: The API is not thread safe and can cause runtime failures.

rules.title: EventSource class should be sealed
rules.description: The event source implementation must follow special rules to avoid hitting runtime errors.

rules.title: EventSource implementation is not correct
rules.description: The event source implementation must follow special rules to avoid hitting runtime errors.
